theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_si_coarea_null_sets
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), Measurable f → Measurable G → (∀ g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖G x‖ₑ * g x ∂μ) → (∀ c : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict M), f x = c → G x = 0) ∧ ∀ Z : Set (Eucl P), Z ⊆ M → μ Z = 0 → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ν (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0
